_note: Sentinel Watchlists are how threat intel actually gets joined against log data in KQL — via the _GetWatchlist() function. This schema defines the watchlist this phase's new detection rule (ti-watchlist-match.kql) queries against.
description: Curated IOC list — IPs, domains, file hashes, URLs — sourced from Defender Threat Intelligence and manually vetted feeds. Joined against SigninLogs, DeviceNetworkEvents, and EmailEvents via _GetWatchlist('ThreatIntelIOCs') in detections/kql/ti-watchlist-match.kql.

schema.IndicatorValue: string — the IP, domain, hash, or URL itself
schema.IndicatorType: string — one of: ip | domain | file_hash | url
schema.Confidence: int — 0-100, sourced from the TI provider's own confidence score
schema.SourceFeed: string — where this indicator came from, for provenance
schema.Expiration: datetime — IOCs age out; a 2-year-old IP indicator is often noise, not signal
